text: Workspace Tints 是一款面向 DSH 网页端的侧栏界面插件。它为每个工作区分配并记住柔和色调，在工作区标题和所属会话旁添加色彩提示，同时把工作区显示为分组标题、将会话缩进排列；已完成但未读的会话整行显示绿色。设置页可查看各工作区色调并在柔和、微光、关闭之间调整色彩强度。适合需要在长侧栏中区分多个工作区和会话的用户。插件在浏览器 localStorage 保存色调分配与强度，不需要额外 API 密钥或账号。

Workspace Tints adds soft colors and grouping to the DSH web sidebar. It colors workspace headers and sessions, indents sessions under headings, and marks completed unread sessions in green. Settings offer three tint levels. Choices stay in browser localStorage; no API key is needed.
想让 DSH 侧栏里的多个工作区更容易区分。
能不能把工作区和会话显示成清晰的层级？
How can I make workspace groups easier to scan in the DSH sidebar?
Workspace Tints 的工作区色调功能：为工作区分配稳定的柔和色调，并把相同色调标记应用到工作区标题及其会话行。新增工作区会选择与现有色调尽量分开的色调。
Workspace Tints 的侧栏层级功能：将工作区名称作为分组标题、把所属会话缩进显示，并为已完成但仍未读的会话整行添加绿色渐变提示。层级和绿色状态提示不随色阶强度关闭。

dsh-workspace-tints README · Workspace Tints：A quiet colour code for Workspaces in [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/) — plus a green row the moment a chat finishes without you.

[Source](https://github.com/Veduis/dsh-workspace-tints) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workspace-tints) · [veduis.com](https://veduis.com)

dsh-workspace-tints README · What it does：**One tint per Workspace.** Every Workspace takes a tone from a single warm-to-cool ramp of tinted whites — never a saturated accent. The tone washes the Workspace header and draws a 2px rail beside each of its Sessions, so five open projects read as five sections instead of one long list.

dsh-workspace-tints README · What it does：**A tree, not a list.** Workspace names are set as section headings (15px, semibold, with air above them); their Sessions indent beneath in a smaller size (13px). The rail stays at the row edge, so it reads as the group's spine while the contents step in.

dsh-workspace-tints README · What it does：**A green row for finished chats.** When a Session finishes while you are elsewhere, the whole row takes a green gradient — the exact green of the status dot that already turns for it. Green is the one colour the Workspace ramp never uses, so the two signals can't be confused. The row clears the moment you open the chat.

| Dark | Light |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |

dsh-workspace-tints README · What it does：**You can turn the volume down.** Settings → *Workspace tints* shows every Workspace's current tone and switches the intensity between **Soft**, **Whisper**, and **Off**. The hierarchy and the finished-chat green are structural signals and stay on; only the tint intensity is switchable.

dsh-workspace-tints README · Install：From a shell:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-workspace-tints
```

Or in the app: **Plugins → Install**, and give the package name `dsh-workspace-tints`. Reload the page if your profile does not use HMR.

It is also listed in a plugin market index, so Discover can install it without typing a package name: add `https://veduis.github.io/dsh-workspace-tints/index.json` as an index source (Plugins → More → Custom plugin markets → Discover → Add index source).

dsh-workspace-tints README · Install：Requires a DeepSeek Harness build satisfying `engines.dsh` (currently `^0.2.1-rc.5`). The package is a bundle: `cordis.patch.yml` inserts one `workspace-tints` row, whose Client half is the stylesheet and the Settings section.

dsh-workspace-tints README · How a tone is chosen：Sessions outside every Workspace stay neutral.

One migration note: assignments made before 1.0.0 are re-anchored to the green-free ramp by nearest hue, once, on first load.

dsh-workspace-tints README · What it touches：The plugin owns one `<style>` element plus the Settings section. It reads Workspace metadata through the public `ctx.workspaces` Client service and never reads another plugin's state. Rows are addressed by the sidebar's own `data-row-key` identity (`workspace:<id>`, `session:<id>`) and the status dot's `data-state="done"`; if a future client version renames those, the affected effect stops applying and nothing else changes.
dsh-workspace-tints README · What it touches：No network access, no telemetry, no analytics. The only persisted state is the tone map and intensity in `localStorage`.

dsh-workspace-tints README · Compatibility：| DSH | Plugin |
| --- | --- |
| `^0.2.1-rc.5` | 1.0.x |

The client APIs used (`ctx.workspaces`, `ctx.slots`, `ctx.locale`, `ctx.effect`, `ctx.provide`) are stable in that range. A wider range will be declared once verified against a newer runtime.

dsh-workspace-tints README · Uninstall：**Plugins → Workspace Tints → Remove**, or:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-workspace-tints
```

The stylesheet and Settings section are disposed with the bundle. The stored tone map stays in `localStorage`, so reinstalling restores the same colours.

dsh-workspace-tints README · About the screenshots：The images above are rendered from the plugin's own CSS against the shipped theme tokens. The Workspace and Session names in them — Aurora Studio, Lighthouse Ops, Paper Kite, Foundry Labs, Cedar & Co — are invented for the demo.
